name: Azure Cosmos DB Pattern
summary: Design, implement, refactor and audit Azure Cosmos DB for NoSQL access patterns: partition and id routing, indexing and RUs, consistency and session tokens, transactions and ETags, change feed, vectors, RBAC, encryption, continuous and periodic backup, new-account and in-account restore, monitoring and ARM/CLI provisioning, with command routes that load one guide at a time.
security_notes: Not permission to access Azure. Live reads need a confirmed subscription, resource group, account and container; writes, restores, feature changes and load tests need exact approval. Bundled scripts are offline route selectors, a date-argument review reminder, an asset validator and a sanitized recovery guard.
